sections: P7 — Cut Environment Inventory and flow

repo_truth: The shared worktree now exposes a green selected Charter observation/projection with canonical path, source fingerprint, in-memory Markdown bytes, and rendered fingerprint; Project Context observation is retained. A separate lane owns compiler/CLI/skill/setup/doctor. This lane owns only Environment Inventory reference carriers and flow/C04 cutover.
allowed_scope: Edit Environment Inventory Charter reference/preflight carriers in compiler/core fixtures without changing Environment Inventory content authority.
Edit engine canonical-artifact/manifest carriers and flow selection, budget, freshness, result/refusal projections needed to source selected Charter YAML and render it in memory.
Edit compiler/flow C04 DTO version gates together to accept reduced-v1-m8.3 and reject reduced-v1-m8.2 while preserving C03 reduced-v1-m8 generation 1 byte-for-byte.
Add focused compiler/flow/Environment Inventory tests and fixtures proving legacy Charter Markdown has zero influence and Project Context behavior is unchanged.

Use RED tests first with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=D:\codex-build\handbook-hcm22 and TEMP/TMP=D:\codex-temp\handbook-hcm22. Run GitNexus impact before every existing function/class/method edit and pause for parent authorization before HIGH or CRITICAL edits.
non_goals: Do not edit profile_inspection.rs, lib.rs, definition/schema/profile/security/transaction internals, CLI command grammar, Charter acquisition skills, setup, doctor, proof/control, planning, handoff, ledger, or dispatch files.
Do not change Environment Inventory content, Project Context ownership/bridge, C03 freshness preimage/generation, Feature Spec, or unrelated pipeline behavior.
Do not add a second authoring path, dual-read fallback, live selected Markdown Charter root, or HCM-2.3.
Do not commit or create handoffs, ledger rows, dispatches, or user-visible task hops.
tasks: Read the complete dispatch, exact P7/product/bridge authority, selected Charter projection API, and every live legacy Charter consumer/carrier.

Write RED tests that prove Environment Inventory references selected Charter YAML/source fingerprint, flow renders selected Charter in memory, legacy Markdown has zero budget/freshness/manifest/log/fixture influence, C04 .3/.2 behavior is exact, and C03/Project Context are unchanged.
Run and report GitNexus impact for every existing seam; pause on HIGH/CRITICAL before editing.
After parent authorization, implement the smallest coherent carrier cutover and return focused GREEN evidence plus exact remaining legacy references, if any.
contracts_and_gates: BR-HCM-2-CHARTER-FLOW-01 is a separately named temporary bridge that loads selected canonical YAML, validates current authority/lifecycle, renders in memory, and projects selected path plus source/render fingerprints.
No legacy Charter Markdown/input byte can affect selection, budget, manifest, freshness, blockers, logs, summaries, sections, notes, fixtures, or compiler/CLI carriers after cutover.
Environment Inventory content remains fixed; only its Charter reference/preflight carrier changes.
C04 advances atomically to reduced-v1-m8.3; C03 remains reduced-v1-m8 generation 1 with an unchanged preimage.
stop_conditions: Pause and report before any HIGH or CRITICAL existing-symbol edit.
Return blocked if removing a live selected Markdown consumer requires scope beyond named engine/compiler/flow/fixture boundaries.
Return blocked rather than changing C03, Project Context, Environment Inventory content, or adding a dual truth path.
